constraints: If process names a nonexistent process not created by CALL WORKER or 4D itself, the command does nothing; if it names a nonexistent worker by name, a new worker process is created.
The main process (always process number 1) is a worker process callable via CALL WORKER, but should be addressed by number since its name varies by language.
Arrays cannot be passed as parameters to formula.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Creates (if needed) and posts a formula (with optional parameters) to the message box of the named/numbered worker process, requesting it execute the formula in its own context.
